# Kome.Records known-answer vectors. Read by tests/test_records.adb.
# One vector per line: <case> <tag||content hex> <h hex>, "#" starts a comment.
# Each line is the frame (without its 64-byte signature) of one record whose
# inputs the test builds with Make_* from the same fixed values, and h =
# BLAKE2b-256 (tag || content). Both were produced by a short Python script
# written from the DESIGN.md layout text (not from Kome.Records), with
# hashlib.blake2b (digest_size=32) for h and for ns = BLAKE2b-256 (root_pk ||
# salt)[0:16]. Filler: fill(n, s)[i] = (s + 7 i) mod 256.
#   put1     ns=fill(16,1) ent=fill(16,2) field=fill(5,3) t=0x010203040506
#            seq=7 author=fill(32,4) value=fill(10,5)

#   del1     same ns, ent, author; t=1234 seq=2^48-1
#   roster1  root_pk=fill(32,8) salt=fill(16,9) signer=fill(32,10)
#            prev_h=fill(32,11) gen=3 ceiling_t=1000 del_ttl=86400000
#            epoch=513 roots=fill(64,12) (2) members=fill(272,13) (2)
#   roster2  same root_pk, salt; signer=root_pk prev_h=0, all integers 0,
#            no roots, no members

#            rev_seq=1
